name: video-production
description: Request-driven video production for any style or length: visual canvas, Manor media generation, editable assembly, verified delivery, and requested publication handoff.

invocation_policy.semantic_trigger: the user asks in natural language to plan, generate, or substantially remake a video of any genre or length from a brief, script, uploaded reference, or product reference, optionally with a publication destination; a narrow edit to an existing approved timeline stays with video-edit, and publishing an already finished asset alone uses the relevant platform workflow

examples: produce promo video with ai footage
create storyboard first and last frames
video ad for social media from brief
